name: thruk_list_hosts
description: List monitored hosts. Filters: `hostgroup`, `state` (up/down/unreachable), `name_regex` (CI regex), `custom_vars` (Nagios custom variables, e.g. {"KERNEL": "windows"}). Pagination: `limit` (max 1000), `offset`. Sort: `sort` (e.g. 'name', '-state'). Columns: by default a tight subset is returned to save tokens. Pass an empty string `columns=''` to return ALL columns, or a custom comma list.

custom_vars.title: Custom Vars
custom_vars.description: Filter by Nagios custom variables. Dict of {VARNAME: value} pairs translated to Thruk REST _VARNAME=value params (auto-uppercased). Example: {"KERNEL": "windows"}.

name: thruk_get_host
description: Get a single host by name.

name: thruk_list_services
description: List monitored services. Filters: `host`, `servicegroup`, `state` (ok/warning/critical/unknown), `description_regex`, `custom_vars` (service-level Nagios custom variables), `host_custom_vars` (host-level custom variables on the parent host). Pagination via `limit`/`offset`, sort via `sort` (e.g. '-last_state_change'). Default columns are a tight subset to save tokens; pass `columns=''` for all columns or a custom comma list.

custom_vars.title: Custom Vars
custom_vars.description: Filter by service-level Nagios custom variables. Dict of {VARNAME: value} pairs translated to _VARNAME=value REST params. Example: {"CRITICALITY": "prod"}.

host_custom_vars.title: Host Custom Vars
host_custom_vars.description: Filter services by host-level Nagios custom variables. Dict of {VARNAME: value} pairs translated to _HOSTVARNAME=value REST params. Example: {"KERNEL": "windows"}.

name: thruk_get_service
description: Get a single service by host and description.

name: thruk_host_availability
description: Compute availability (uptime / SLA %) for a host over a configurable time window. Returns time_up_percent, time_down_percent, time_unreachable_percent and scheduled_* equivalents. since/until accept Thruk relative times or ISO datetimes. timeperiod (e.g. lastmonth, last24hours) overrides since/until.

name: thruk_service_availability
description: Compute availability (uptime / SLA %) for a service over a configurable time window. Returns time_ok_percent, time_warning_percent, time_critical_percent, time_unknown_percent and scheduled_* equivalents. since/until accept Thruk relative times or ISO datetimes. timeperiod (e.g. lastmonth, last24hours) overrides since/until.

name: thruk_hostgroup_availability
description: Compute availability (uptime / SLA %) for all hosts/services in a hostgroup. Returns a list sorted by time_up_percent ascending (worst performers first). type param: hosts (default), services, or both. since/until accept Thruk relative times or ISO datetimes. timeperiod (e.g. lastmonth, last24hours) overrides since/until.

name: thruk_list_hostgroups
description: List host groups. Default columns return name/alias and host/service counts only.

name: thruk_list_servicegroups
description: List service groups. Default columns return name/alias and counts only.

name: thruk_list_contacts
description: List configured Nagios/Naemon contacts (notification targets). Default columns: name, alias, email, pager, host_notifications_enabled, service_notifications_enabled. Pass `columns=''` for the full contact record.

name: thruk_get_contact
description: Get a single Nagios/Naemon contact by name. Hits GET /thruk/r/contacts/{name} and returns the full record (email, pager, notification commands and timeperiods, host/service notification flags, contact groups, custom variables). Raises ThrukError (404 surfaced verbatim) if the contact does not exist.

name: thruk_problems
description: List all current unhandled host/service problems (not acknowledged, not in downtime). Sorted by worst state first. Default columns are tight; pass `columns=''` for all. Optional `custom_vars` restricts by Nagios custom variables; `host_custom_vars` restricts service problems by host-level custom variables.

custom_vars.title: Custom Vars
custom_vars.description: Filter problems by Nagios custom variables (host own vars in the hosts query, service own vars in the services query). Example: {"ENV": "prod"}.

host_custom_vars.title: Host Custom Vars
host_custom_vars.description: Filter service problems by host-level Nagios custom variables. Translated to _HOSTVARNAME=value. Example: {"KERNEL": "windows"}.

hostgroup.title: Hostgroup
hostgroup.description: Restrict both hosts and services sub-queries to hosts belonging to this hostgroup name (exact match via groups[gte] / host_groups[gte]). Example: linux-servers.

name: thruk_stats
description: Aggregated host/service statistics. Optional `filter` (structured AND/OR tree) scopes both /hosts/stats and /services/stats. Fields: hostgroup, custom_var.

field.description: The monitoring attribute to filter on.

op.description: Comparison operator: eq (=), neq (≠), regex (case-insensitive ~), in (list), gte (≥), lte (≤).

value.description: Comparison value. Use a list for op='in'. For custom_var / host_custom_var use {"var": "NAME", "val": "value"}.

operator.description: Logical operator applied to all conditions.

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree. Fields: hostgroup, custom_var. Compiled twice -- groups[gte] on /hosts/stats, host_groups[gte] on /services/stats; custom_var -> _VARNAME on both.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_totals
description: Compact host+service counts (16 fields vs ~100 from thruk_stats). Calls /hosts/totals and /services/totals concurrently. Optional `filter` (AND/OR tree). Fields: hostgroup, servicegroup, custom_var. servicegroup is only forwarded to /services/totals.

field.description: The monitoring attribute to filter on.

op.description: Comparison operator: eq (=), neq (≠), regex (case-insensitive ~), in (list), gte (≥), lte (≤).

value.description: Comparison value. Use a list for op='in'. For custom_var use {"var": "NAME", "val": "value"}.

operator.description: Logical operator applied to all conditions.

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree. Fields: hostgroup, servicegroup, custom_var. hostgroup -> groups[gte] on /hosts/totals and host_groups[gte] on /services/totals; servicegroup -> groups[gte] on /services/totals only (stripped from host-side params); custom_var -> _VARNAME on both.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_list_downtimes
description: List scheduled downtimes.

name: thruk_get_downtime
description: Get a single downtime by id.

name: thruk_list_comments
description: List comments (acknowledgements appear here too).

name: thruk_sites
description: List configured Thruk backends (sites).

name: thruk_list_logs
description: Query raw Livestatus log entries (/logs). Time arguments accept Thruk relative timestamps (e.g. '-24h', '-7d', '-30m') or absolute unix epoch. Default window: last 24h. Sort '-time' = newest first. Pagination via `limit`/`offset`. Default columns are a tight subset; pass `columns=''` for all columns.

name: thruk_list_alerts
description: List HOST/SERVICE ALERT entries from the log (/alerts). Optional `state` filters alert state: up/down/unreachable for hosts, ok/warning/critical/unknown for services.

name: thruk_list_notifications
description: List notification entries from the log (/notifications, class=3). Optional `contact` filters notifications sent to a specific contact name.

hostgroup.title: Hostgroup
hostgroup.description: Filter notifications to hosts belonging to this hostgroup (current_host_groups[gte] on /logs). Requires live Livestatus backend; may be silently ignored on logcache backends.

name: thruk_notification_summary
description: Count notifications grouped by a single dimension (contact, host, service, state or command) over a time window. The notification equivalent of thruk_top_noisy_hosts: aggregates /logs class=3 entries and returns per-group counts sorted descending.

field.description: The monitoring attribute to filter on.

op.description: Comparison operator: eq (=), neq (≠), regex (case-insensitive ~), in (list), gte (≥), lte (≤).

value.description: Comparison value. Use a list for op='in'. For custom_var / host_custom_var use {"var": "NAME", "val": "value"}.

operator.description: Logical operator applied to all conditions.

filter.description: Structured filter tree supporting AND/OR nesting. Available fields: contact, custom_var, host, hostgroup, service, since, state, until. Operators: eq, gte, in, lte, neq, regex.

group_by.description: Dimension to group notification counts by: 'contact' (default), 'host', 'service', 'state' or 'command'.

since.description: Start of analysis window. Thruk relative time ("-2h", "-7d") or ISO datetime ("2026-05-21 14:00:00"). Default: last 24 h.

until.description: End of analysis window. Omit for now.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_recent_events
description: Return the most recent monitoring events from the last N hours (default 1h). Defaults to all log classes; set `only_alerts=True` to restrict to HOST/SERVICE ALERT entries.

hostgroup.title: Hostgroup
hostgroup.description: Filter events to hosts belonging to this hostgroup (current_host_groups[gte] on /logs). Requires live Livestatus backend; may be silently ignored on logcache backends.

name: thruk_query
description: Escape hatch: call any Thruk REST endpoint. `path` is everything after `/thruk/r` (e.g. `/hosts/srv01/services`). `params` is the query string, `data` the form body. See https://www.thruk.org/documentation/rest.html for the full catalogue.

name: thruk_run_background_query
description: Run a potentially long Thruk REST request via the `background=1` mechanism. The server returns a job id immediately, then we poll `/thruk/jobs/<id>/output` until completion (default 5 min timeout). Use this for expensive queries: full config dumps, large availability reports, recursive config checks. Same `path` semantics as `thruk_query`.

name: thruk_schedule_downtime
description: Schedule a host or service downtime. Time accepts 'now', relative ('+2h', '+30m') or ISO 8601. If `duration_minutes` is set it overrides `end_time`.

name: thruk_schedule_host_services_downtime
description: Schedule a downtime on ALL services of the given host (schedule_host_svc_downtime). Use thruk_schedule_downtime for the host itself or for one specific service.

name: thruk_schedule_propagated_host_downtime
description: Schedule a downtime on a host and propagate to all child hosts. If `triggered=True`, child downtimes are triggered by the parent (start when the parent enters its downtime). Useful for a parent network device whose children should automatically follow.

name: thruk_schedule_hostgroup_downtime
description: Schedule a downtime for every host (`target='hosts'`, default) or every service (`target='services'`) of a hostgroup.

name: thruk_schedule_servicegroup_downtime
description: Schedule a downtime on a servicegroup. `target='services'` (default) targets all services in the group; `target='hosts'` targets the hosts owning those services.

name: thruk_delete_downtime
description: Delete a host or service downtime by its id.

name: thruk_delete_active_downtimes
description: Remove ALL currently active downtimes for a host (or one specific service when `service` is given). No need to know individual ids.

name: thruk_delete_downtimes_by_filter
description: Bulk-delete downtimes matching arbitrary filters via the system commands `del_downtime_by_host_name`, `del_downtime_by_hostgroup_name` or `del_downtime_by_start_time_comment`. At least one filter must be provided; the most specific endpoint is selected automatically.

name: thruk_acknowledge
description: Acknowledge a host or service problem.

name: thruk_bulk_acknowledge
description: Acknowledge every unhandled host/service problem matching the given filters in one MCP call. Optional filters: hostgroup, state ('down'|'unreachable'|'critical'|'warning'|'unknown'), hosts_only, services_only. Pagination is handled internally. Returns {acknowledged, failed, targets, errors}; emits an informational _warning when no targets match.

state.description: Restrict to a single state: 'down' / 'unreachable' (hosts) or 'critical' / 'warning' / 'unknown' (services). None (default) matches every non-OK problem.
state.title: State

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.
backends.title: Backends

name: thruk_add_comment
description: Add a free-form operator comment on a host or service. Posts a timestamped note via Thruk REST without acknowledging the problem or scheduling a downtime. Use for incident timeline annotations, false-positive markers, ops handoff notes. Set persistent=False to drop the comment on the next check result.

comment.description: Free-form comment text to attach to the host or service.
comment.title: Comment

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.
backends.title: Backends

name: thruk_delete_comment
description: Delete a host or service comment by its id. Closes the CRUD loop together with thruk_list_comments and thruk_add_comment (issue #169). host is required so Thruk can route the command to the correct backend; provide service for service-scoped comments. Uses the command-based path (POST /hosts/{host}/cmd/del_host_comment or POST /services/{host}/{svc}/cmd/del_svc_comment) with payload comment_id, which is portable across Thruk versions.

comment_id.description: Numeric comment id (as returned by thruk_list_comments).
comment_id.title: Comment Id

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.
backends.title: Backends

name: thruk_remove_acknowledgement
description: Remove an acknowledgement.

name: thruk_recheck
description: Schedule an immediate (re)check for a host or service.

name: thruk_checks
description: Enable or disable active checks for a host or service. Set enabled=true to enable, enabled=false to disable. When service is omitted the command targets the host itself. Set cascade=true to also apply to all services of the host (ignored when service is specified). Does not affect passive check submissions.

enabled.description: True to enable active checks, False to disable.

service.description: Service description. Omit to target the host only (use cascade=true to also cover all its services).

cascade.description: When true and no service is specified, also apply to all services of the host. Ignored when service is set.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_notifications
description: Enable or disable notifications for a host or service. Set enabled=true to enable, enabled=false to disable. When service is omitted the command targets the host itself. Set cascade=true to also apply to all services of the host (ignored when service is specified).

enabled.description: True to enable notifications, False to disable.

service.description: Service description. Omit to target the host only (use cascade=true to also cover all its services).

cascade.description: When true and no service is specified, also apply to all services of the host. Ignored when service is set.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

op.description: Comparison operator: eq (=), neq (≠), regex (case-insensitive ~), in (list), gte (≥), lte (≤).

name: thruk_oldest_problems
description: Unhandled problems (DOWN/UNREACHABLE hosts and WARNING/CRITICAL/UNKNOWN services, not acknowledged, not in downtime) sorted by age ascending — oldest first. Returns [{host, service, state, since, duration_human}]. Optional structured ``filter`` (fields: hostgroup, custom_var) scopes both /hosts and /services queries.

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree. Supported fields: hostgroup, custom_var.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_unacked_critical
description: CRITICAL services and DOWN/UNREACHABLE hosts not acknowledged for more than N minutes. Returns [{host, service, state, duration_minutes}] sorted by duration descending. Optional structured ``filter`` (fields: hostgroup, custom_var) scopes both /hosts and /services queries.

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree. Supported fields: hostgroup, custom_var.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_stale_acks
description: Acknowledgements older than N days (potentially forgotten). Queries /comments with entry_type=4. Returns [{host, service, ack_author, ack_comment, ack_since_days}] sorted by age descending. Optional structured ``filter`` (fields: hostgroup, custom_var) scopes the review to a perimeter via a concurrent /hosts resolution (host-name intersection).

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree. Supported fields: hostgroup, custom_var.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_problem_counts

Calls /hosts/totals and /services/totals concurrently and projects to non-OK / non-pending fields only: hosts -> {down, unreachable, down_and_unhandled, unreachable_and_unhandled}; services -> {warning, critical, unknown, warning_and_unhandled, critical_and_unhandled, unknown_and_unhandled}. Optional `filter` (AND/OR tree). Fields: hostgroup, servicegroup, custom_var. Same filter contract as thruk_totals.

field.description: The monitoring attribute to filter on.

op.description: Comparison operator: eq (=), neq (≠), regex (case-insensitive ~), in (list), gte (≥), lte (≤).

value.description: Comparison value. Use a list for op='in'. For custom_var use {"var": "NAME", "val": "value"}.

operator.description: Logical operator applied to all conditions.

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree. Fields: hostgroup, servicegroup, custom_var. hostgroup -> groups[gte] on /hosts/totals and host_groups[gte] on /services/totals; servicegroup -> groups[gte] on /services/totals only (stripped from host-side params); custom_var -> _VARNAME on both.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_alert_heatmap
description: Return alert counts grouped by time bucket over a window. Useful for spotting alert storms, quiet periods, and recurring patterns. Buckets with zero alerts are included for a continuous timeline.

since.description: Start of analysis window. Thruk relative time ("-2h", "-7d") or ISO datetime ("2026-05-21 14:00:00"). Default: last 24 h.

until.description: End of analysis window. Omit for now.

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree. Fields: host, service, hostgroup, custom_var.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_notification_heatmap
description: Return notification counts grouped by time bucket over a window. The notification (class=3) counterpart of thruk_alert_heatmap: useful for spotting notification/mail storms, quiet periods and recurring paging patterns. Buckets with zero notifications are included for a continuous timeline.

since.description: Start of analysis window. Thruk relative time ("-2h", "-7d") or ISO datetime ("2026-05-21 14:00:00"). Default: last 24 h.

until.description: End of analysis window. Omit for now.

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree. Fields: host, service, contact, state, hostgroup, custom_var, since, until.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_concurrent_failures
description: Detect time windows where multiple hosts failed concurrently. Fetches HOST ALERT DOWN/UNREACHABLE log entries, applies a sliding window, and returns merged bursts where at least min_hosts distinct hosts failed. Useful for detecting network incidents or datacenter outages.

since.description: Start of analysis window. Thruk relative time ("-2h", "-7d") or ISO datetime. Default: last 1 h.

until.description: End of analysis window. Omit for now.

min_hosts.description: Minimum number of distinct failing hosts to constitute a burst (default 3).

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree. Fields: host, hostgroup, custom_var.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_stale_checks
description: Surface checks that stopped running (the dangerous false green): a check that stops executing keeps showing its last state (usually OK) while monitoring is blind. Scans /services (and /hosts) and flags each abnormal check by reason: stale (active check overdue vs check_interval*60*staleness_factor + grace), stale_passive (passive check older than passive_max_age_s), never_checked (has_been_checked=0), disabled (active_checks_enabled=0, reported separately), high_latency (latency > latency_threshold_s). check_interval is in MINUTES in Livestatus and converted to seconds. Spurious latency values are sanitized. Returns {now, thresholds, counts, results} sorted stalest-first.

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree scoping both /services and /hosts. Fields: hostgroup, custom_var.

staleness_factor.description: Multiplier on the active check_interval before a check is considered stale (now - last_check > interval*factor + grace_seconds).

latency_threshold_s.description: Latency in seconds above which a check is flagged with reason=high_latency.

grace_seconds.description: Absolute grace (seconds) added on top of interval*factor / passive_max_age_s to avoid boundary flapping (default 60).

passive_max_age_s.description: Max age in seconds of a passive check's last result before reason=stale_passive (default 3600).

include_hosts.description: Also run the same logic over /hosts host checks (default true).

include_disabled.description: Report active checks with active_checks_enabled=0 as reason=disabled (default true).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows scanned per object type (max 5000, default 500).

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_recurring_problems
description: Return hosts/services that generated repeated alerts over a time window. Identifies chronic problems by counting non-recovery HOST/SERVICE ALERT entries per object and filtering by a minimum threshold. Results sorted by alert count descending.

since.description: Start of analysis window. Thruk relative time ("-2h", "-7d") or ISO datetime ("2026-05-21 14:00:00"). Default: last 24 h.

until.description: End of analysis window. Omit for now.

min_alerts.description: Minimum number of non-recovery alert events to be included (default 5, must be >= 1).

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree. Fields: host, service, hostgroup, custom_var.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_get_perfdata
description: Fetch and parse performance data for a single host (service omitted) or service. Returns a list of metrics {label, value, uom, warn, crit, min, max, breached}; warn/crit are raw Nagios range strings and breached is range-correct. Empty perf_data yields metrics: [] (never an error).

service.description: Service description. Omit for the host check's own perfdata.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_perfdata_snapshot
description: Parsed performance data for every service matching a structured filter, in one call. Use case: capacity planning (CPU/RAM of every host in a hostgroup). Returns {host, service, metrics:[...]} rows.

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree over /services. Fields: host, description, state, hostgroup, servicegroup, custom_var, host_custom_var.

limit.description: Maximum number of services to scan (max 1000).

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_perfdata_near_threshold
description: Metrics whose value is within within_percent %% of breaching their warn (or crit) range, computed range-correctly (handles inverted lower-is-worse metrics). Sorted by headroom_percent ascending; 0 means already breached.

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree over /services. Fields: host, description, state, hostgroup, servicegroup, custom_var, host_custom_var.

limit.description: Maximum number of services to scan (max 1000).

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.

name: thruk_reliability_report
description: Per host/service reliability metrics (MTTR, MTBF, incident count, longest outage) reconstructed from HARD HOST/SERVICE ALERT transitions in the log. Unlike *_availability (uptime %% only), this distinguishes many short outages from one long one. SOFT rows, downtime/flapping alerts and notifications are ignored; consecutive non-OK HARD states collapse into one incident; ongoing incidents are clamped at until and excluded from MTTR. Results sorted by total downtime descending.

since.description: Start of analysis window. Thruk relative time ("-30d", "-7d") or ISO datetime ("2026-05-21 14:00:00"). Default: last 30 days.

until.description: End of analysis window. Omit for now.

limit.description: Maximum number of host/service objects to return (busiest first, default 50).

filter.description: Structured AND/OR filter tree. Fields: host, service, hostgroup, custom_var.

backends.description: Comma-separated backend names (sites). Omit for all backends.
